Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I request a leave of absence?
A: Submit the leave application through the student portal and get approval from the academic advisor.

Q: Where can I check my exam timetable?
A: The timetable is published on the student portal and notices board.

Q: Can I submit a project late?
A: Late submission is allowed only with tutor approval and may incur a grade penalty.

Campus Notices

- The library will remain open until 9:00 PM during examination week.
- Students should check the official email for updates about deadlines and cancellations.
- The workshop registration form is now open for all interested students.
- Technical support can be reached through the student help desk during office hours.

Academic Regulations

- Students must submit assignments before the stated deadline.
- For late submissions, approval from the course tutor is required.
- Cheating, plagiarism, or unauthorized collaboration is strictly prohibited.
- Students are expected to maintain respectful conduct in classes and online forums.
- During examinations, mobile phones and unauthorized material are not allowed.
- Students should carry their student ID card at all times during institutional activities.

Course Syllabus Overview

- Introduction to Python Programming
- Database Fundamentals
- Web Development Basics
- Research and Presentation Skills
- Final assessment includes quizzes, assignments, and a project.
- Attendance requirement: students must maintain at least 75% attendance.

Students should complete weekly assignments and prepare for labs. The academic calendar is published at the start of each semester.
